question: How do declared measurement noise, sparse state-channel access, and exactly redundant observed coordinates affect instantaneous state reconstruction and held-out forced-response prediction when the physical two-layer EBM, forcing protocols, discovery split, and controlled-linear fitting method are held fixed?
hypothesis: The clean two-temperature state remains an exact structural control; Gaussian noise degrades full-state reconstruction and prediction without changing its structural observation rank; a noisy surface-only view loses instantaneous access to the deep state; duplicating that exact same noisy surface measurement increases observed coordinate dimension but not structural rank and should not materially change decoded state or forced-response error.

datasets.quality_control_policy: physical parameters must be finite and positive; malformed states fail closed

datasets.time_domain: discovery forcing interval plus held-out step, ramp, overshoot/reversal, and sign-reversal confirmation protocols
datasets.quality_control_policy: confirmation domain contains discovery domain and all confirmation protocols are immutable experiment inputs

datasets.time_domain: fixed one-year transition samples for discovery fitting
datasets.quality_control_policy: training forcing endpoints are sampled only inside the declared discovery domain; confirmation protocol identities are fixed before execution

datasets.time_domain: same discovery and held-out confirmation transitions as the forced-representation v1 control
datasets.quality_control_policy: observation matrices, noise standard deviation, discovery/confirmation seeds, named-noise reuse, and fixed pseudoinverse policy are immutable; the duplicated surface pair reuses one identical noisy measurement and must remain structural rank one

primary_metrics.aggregation_domain: reported separately for each declared representation over all held-out confirmation current states using only the fixture-declared fixed observation pseudoinverse
primary_metrics.missing_data_policy: every representation and every confirmation protocol is required

primary_metrics.aggregation_domain: reported separately for each declared representation over all held-out next states after discovery-only controlled-linear fitting and fixed observation reconstruction
primary_metrics.missing_data_policy: every representation and every confirmation protocol is required

primary_metrics.aggregation_domain: rank of each fixture-declared noiseless observation matrix, reported separately by representation
primary_metrics.missing_data_policy: every declared observation matrix is required
primary_metrics.uncertainty_method: exact structural diagnostic up to the fixed numerical rank convention

secondary_metrics.aggregation_domain: number of observed coordinates reported separately by representation
observation dimension minus structural observation rank, reported separately by representation
secondary_metrics.missing_data_policy: dimension and structural rank are required

secondary_metrics.aggregation_domain: redundant noisy surface-pair structural rank minus noisy surface-scalar structural rank
redundant-pair minus surface-scalar held-out state-reconstruction error under the same reused noisy surface samples
redundant-pair minus surface-scalar held-out forced-state prediction error under the same reused noisy surface samples
surface-scalar minus noisy-full-state held-out forced-state prediction error
secondary_metrics.missing_data_policy: noisy full-state and noisy surface-scalar representations are required

secondary_metrics.aggregation_domain: held-out forced-state prediction error for the unchanged clean two-temperature state control

negative_controls: the clean two-temperature observation map is retained as the exact full-state control under the same discovery/confirmation forcing split
the noisy full-state, surface-only, and redundant surface views reuse the same named surface-noise samples so representation comparisons cannot benefit from a luckier surface-noise draw
the redundant surface pair duplicates one identical noisy measurement rather than adding an independent sensor; its observed dimension is two but its noiseless observation matrix rank remains one
state reconstruction uses only the fixed pseudoinverse of the declared observation matrix and is never fit on discovery or confirmation target states
the controlled-linear transition model is fit only on discovery transitions; held-out step, ramp, overshoot/reversal, and sign-reversal protocols remain unchanged confirmation data
falsifiers: the redundant noisy surface pair is credited with structural observation rank greater than one
the duplicated surface pair materially changes fixed-decoder reconstruction or forced-response error relative to the identical single noisy surface measurement
the clean full-state control ceases to reproduce the existing near-exact held-out controlled-linear result
confirmation observations influence fitting, observation-map selection, pseudoinverse policy, noise scale, or seeds
the noisy/sparse observation rung is reported as evidence about real observing-system uncertainty rather than a synthetic structural control
split_policy: Reuse the immutable discovery transition design and held-out forcing protocols from the forced-representation v1 rung. Discovery and confirmation use separate fixture-pinned Gaussian noise seeds. No confirmation observation enters fitting or representation selection.
preprocessing: Apply only the fixture-declared linear observation matrices and named Gaussian measurement-noise components. Reconstruct latent state with the fixed Moore-Penrose inverse of the declared noiseless observation matrix; this decoder is not learned.
stopping_rule: Report every representation separately. Preserve the clean full-state exact control, require the redundant two-column surface view to remain structural rank one, and do not collapse reconstruction and forced-response errors into an aggregate representation score.
multiple_comparison_policy: All four representation conditions, all four confirmation protocols, the noise standard deviation, and both observation-noise seeds are fixed by this experiment version; no representation may be removed or retuned after inspecting the results.
